name: advisor
description: One fresh, read-only consultation for material technical decisions.

author.name: David Schmidt / Zero Delta LLC (maintainer); Daniel McAteer (original author)

interface.shortDescription: Read-only advice for material technical decisions.
interface.longDescription: Advisor implicitly matches material architecture, interface, data-model, compatibility, cross-boundary, and competing-diagnosis decisions. The root declares consult or skip before implementation, then surrounds every consult with visible ADVISOR CALL and ADVISOR RESULT receipts. It selects one of two exact role labels by decision risk and invokes the fixed installed-plugin launcher through the escalated-command boundary so a distinct Codex consultation process can start with the pinned Terra or Sol model, High effort, and an explicit read-only sandbox. Post-response inspection rejects malformed, same-session, wrong-model, wrong-effort, non-read-only, or tool-using runs before any result is accepted. Standard consultation and generic advisor requests use Advisor Terra. Advisor Sol is reserved for unresolved security or trust boundaries, irreversible migration or data-loss decisions, and credible unresolved High-severity disagreement. A normal workspace-write root may consult because isolation belongs to the distinct transport. Unavailable evidence is visibly blocked and fail-closed. Advice is non-authoritative, and the plugin never implements, routes work, or performs final review.
defaultPrompt: Use $advisor:consultation for a material technical decision.
Ask Advisor for a fresh, read-only second opinion.
